title: Fix the Illegal Private Field Access
description: The program should read an Account's balance from outside its class using a proper getter.
expectedBehavior: The program should print 100.0, the account's balance.
actualProblem: balance is declared private, so it can only be accessed from within the Account class itself. Trying to read acc.balance from the Bank class is a compile error: 'balance has private access in Account'.
explanation: private fields are only visible inside their own class, which is the point of encapsulation. External code must go through a public method (a getter) to read the value in a controlled way.
